title: Stay at Walter's Carriage House | Rosemary Beach Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Open and well-appointed, Walter's Carriage House is the perfect escape for a small family or group of friends! This charming carriage house is located on the south side of Rosemary Beach, just steps away from a beach access and children's park.

Upon entering, you and your guests will be delighted by a living space that is as airy and laid back as a summer day. Take some time to reconnect over a meal, made possible by the fully equipped kitchen and quaint dining table. When you're ready to relax, head out to the private shuttered balcony. Sit for a spell and enjoy the breathing in the coastal air!

When its time to retire, you will love the luxurious full bathroom on the main floor, made complete with a fabulous jacuzzi tub. Your guests will have no trouble drifting away from the comfort of the queen sleeper sofa, while you head up the stairs to enjoy the privacy of the plush king loft bedroom and half bath.

Walter's Carriage House has everything you need for your next coastal getaway!

This property requires a 4 night minimum stay during spring break and summer and a 2 night minimum stay during shoulder season
